name: rust-fetch-workspace
description: Development workspace for the rust-fetch npm package (published from wasm-module/pkg)

scripts.build: cd wasm-module && wasm-pack build --release --target web && node ../scripts/postbuild.mjs
scripts.test: npm run test:rust && npm run test:js
scripts.test:js: node --test wasm-module/js/test/client.test.mjs wasm-module/js/test/client-js.test.mjs wasm-module/js/test/node-transport.test.mjs wasm-module/js/test/node-transport-js.test.mjs wasm-module/js/test/browser-transport.test.mjs wasm-module/js/test/websocket.test.mjs wasm-module/js/test/events.test.mjs wasm-module/js/test/security.test.mjs wasm-module/js/test/security-js.test.mjs wasm-module/js/test/hardened.test.mjs wasm-module/js/test/memory.test.mjs wasm-module/js/test/v8-crash.test.mjs wasm-module/js/test/package.test.mjs wasm-module/js/test/uploads.test.mjs wasm-module/js/test/uploads-js.test.mjs wasm-module/js/test/observability.test.mjs wasm-module/js/test/observability-js.test.mjs wasm-module/js/test/observability-browser.test.mjs
scripts.coverage:js: node --test --experimental-test-coverage --test-coverage-include=wasm-module/pkg/node.js --test-coverage-lines=100 --test-coverage-functions=100 --test-reporter=spec --test-reporter-destination=stdout --test-reporter=lcov --test-reporter-destination=lcov-js.info wasm-module/js/test/client.test.mjs wasm-module/js/test/client-js.test.mjs wasm-module/js/test/node-transport.test.mjs wasm-module/js/test/node-transport-js.test.mjs wasm-module/js/test/websocket.test.mjs wasm-module/js/test/uploads.test.mjs wasm-module/js/test/uploads-js.test.mjs wasm-module/js/test/observability.test.mjs wasm-module/js/test/observability-js.test.mjs wasm-module/js/test/observability-browser.test.mjs
